pr_summary: Fix a race condition causing deadlock in clustermesh subsystem when stopping remote cluster config fetching. The fix adds a buffer of 1 to the channel (cfgch) in pkg/clustermesh/common/remote_cluster.go to prevent blocking send operations when the receiver has already exited during shutdown.
special_system_dependencies: Linux kernel with eBPF support (for full functionality)
Docker (for container builds and integration tests with kvstores)
patch_file_cues: pkg/clustermesh/common/remote_cluster.go - line 270: change from 'make(chan types.CiliumClusterConfig)' to 'make(chan types.CiliumClusterConfig, 1)' to add buffer and prevent deadlock
test_file_cues: pkg/clustermesh/common/remote_cluster_test.go - TestRemoteClusterWatchdog tests the remote cluster connection and reconnection logic
Integration tests require etcd and consul containers via 'make start-kvstores'
platform_constraint_evidence: Makefile.defs: CGO_CC uses x86_64-linux-gnu-gcc and aarch64-linux-gnu-gcc
README.rst: 'A new Linux kernel technology called eBPF is at the foundation of Cilium'
No Windows or macOS specific build constraints in pkg/clustermesh/
notes: The fix is a simple one-line change adding a buffer to a channel to prevent deadlock. The repository is a Go project using Go modules. Tests can be run with 'go test ./pkg/clustermesh/common/...' or with integration tests requiring Docker containers for etcd and consul. The project targets Linux (AMD64 and ARM64 architectures) as it relies on eBPF which is Linux-specific. Platform constraint is 'linux' because Cilium is fundamentally a Linux networking/security solution built on eBPF, though the specific fix itself is pure Go code that could theoretically run on other platforms.
